name: Shrewsbury Cookies (Biscuits)
ingredients_raw: REFINED WHEAT FLOUR (MAIDA), SUGAR, IMPORTED REFINED PALM OIL & ITS FRACTIONS, SESAME OIL, BUTTER (13.1%), WATER, CORN STARCH, RAISING AGENT [INS500(ii)], EMULSIFYING AGENT (INS 471), ANTIOXIDANT (INS 319), CONTAINS ADDED FLAVOUR (ARTIFICIAL AND NATURE IDENTICAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCE [BUTTER].
